newsitem.title: JAPAN: Monetary policy must focus on recovery - BOJ quoted.
newsitem.headline: Monetary policy must focus on recovery - BOJ quoted.

text.p: Japan's economy is continuing its gradual recovery, and monetary policy should still be geared to strengthening the recovery, Bank of Japan (BOJ) Governor Yasuo Matsushita was quoted as saying on Tuesday.
Matsushita was quoted by Economic Planning Agency (EPA) Minister Taro Aso as also saying that recent growth in Japan's money supply reflected the present state of the economy.

Asked at a meeting of economic ministers whether the growth of money supply, which has been hovering around three percent in recent months, was a sign of asset deflation, Matsushita had said it precisely reflected present economic conditions, Aso said.
